name: Phocas the Deacon
bio: Phocas the Deacon is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no firm date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 772).

poems.title: Book IX, 772: On a Cup in which the Leavings are collected
poems.author: Phocas the Deacon
poems.text: I am dear to the cup-bearer alone, because I collect for him the wine that is left.
